fallbacks.colorSpace: Opaque 8-bit sRGB converted to KDE RGB triples.
fallbacks.fonts: Retain system/application fonts, font sizes and ligature choices.
fallbacks.radius: Window shape and widget geometry remain the Breeze style and KWin decoration.
fallbacks.shadows: Native style/compositor shadows remain unchanged; raised/opaque surfaces express colour depth only.
fallbacks.motion: No global or application animation settings are changed.
fallbacks.interaction: Only Qt colour roles and focus/hover/selection colours are mapped; Plasma panels, GTK, Electron, decorations and unrelated applications are outside this proof of concept.
